|notes=The [[Imperial Justice (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster makes the three stacked cards face-up and restates the one-card choice during battle. The period One Rule limits the singular on-table action to once per battle per copy. Both slips leave the title unrestricted. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 8]. [[:File:VS10O-09-Imperial_Justice.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards10.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 9]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule]. The Virtual Modern blanking concerns a separate publication.
